subject: Datadog + OTel + Grafana: PoC ops plan and risk log
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@observiq.io>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@datadog.com>, partners@grafana.com
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Observability PoC — ops kickoff and quick alignment

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this on. Quick note to align before we kick off the PoC next week: ObservIQ can provide an OTLP relay that sits in front of the Datadog ingestion to help with sampling and tag normalization. Grafana will run the dashboard templates and validate alert hooks.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the test dataset and retention window (we suggest 30 days).
- Shared service account for Datadog ingestion (read/write keys) and a Grafana org invite.
- A short ops runbook for incident replication so support teams can reproduce faults.

I've attached an initial integration checklist and a brief risk register we typically use. Happy to iterate on Wed's call.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations, ObservIQ
---
Attachment: obs-poc-checklist.pdf (stated size: 82KB)
Attachment: obs-risk-template.xlsx (stated size: 45KB)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@observiq.io>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@datadog.com>, partners@grafana.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability PoC — ops kickoff and quick alignment

Thanks Sanjay — this looks good. I pulled together a short ops plan (attached) that covers environment scope, SLAs for synthetic traffic, and rollback criteria. Key callouts: 

- Test data: we'll produce a 72-hour compressed replay (staging) and a continuous 30-day retention in the sandbox project you provision.
- Service accounts: please send the Datadog ingestion key via the secure portal link. We'll create a Grafana org and invite grafana@redwood.example — production access will be locked to the pilot team.
- Runbook: I added two reproducible incident scenarios (high-token-latency and KV-cache-eviction) with exact steps to trigger.

Open risks I've added to the register:
1) Sampling divergence between ObservIQ relay and Datadog backend — may affect alert fidelity.
2) SSO onboarding delay for Grafana org causing dashboard validation slippage.
3) Token throughput mismatch on dedicated nodes if synthetic traffic undershoots.

Can everyone confirm access timelines? I suggested these milestones in the doc: account access by 2028-02-24, baseline ingest by 2028-02-25, smoke test by 2028-02-26.

If that works, I'd like to lock the mutual action outline and send to procurement for an SOW addendum.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Integrations — Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-poc-ops-plan-v1.pdf (stated size: 210KB)
Attachment: risk-register-obs-poc.xlsx (stated size: 56KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability PoC — ops kickoff and quick alignment

Looping in a couple of commercial and product asks:

- Commercial: ObservIQ and Grafana participation is great, but procurement will need the mutual action outline and a rough topline on cost share for the sandbox (we typically ask partners to cover 30% of cloud egress for short pilots). Please add a one-paragraph cost-sharing proposal to the mutual-action-outline.docx.
- Product: Karthik — can you confirm if the KV-cache-eviction scenario requires us to enable experimental batching on the serving runtime? If yes, include the exact flag and expected perf delta in the ops doc.

I can draft the procurement blurb and push to legal once Vivek confirms the timeline.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Vivek / team — thanks for the clear ops doc. Confirming the following from Datadog's side: 

- We can provision a pilot API key with ingestion scope by 2028-02-24 EOD. We'll share the secure portal link separately.
- Grafana: we'll coordinate the org invite and dashboard templates with partners@grafana.com and expect invite accepted by 2028-02-25.
- Sampling: Datadog engineering will run a small comparative check against the ObservIQ relay on 2028-02-25 morning; we'll send a short report and suggested sampling mapping.

Internal note: Ben, agree on a 30% pilot contribution ask — Maria (cc'd) can we have a one-line acknowledgement that Datadog will cover the templated dashboard work and ObservIQ will contribute relay infra? That will make procurement easier.

Next steps:
- Vivek to confirm mutual action outline and share to procurement (expecting SOW addendum).
- Sanjay to share relay access details and Grafana onboarding steps.
- Discovery call scheduled: 2028-02-24 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Strategic Partnerships, Datadog
